## What's new

- **Never miss an update.** When Dowlio finds a new version while you're working in another app, it sends a notification. Click it to see what's new and install. Until you do, the menu bar icon shows a dot, the Dock icon shows a badge, and the menu bar panel, the Library sidebar, Settings › Updates and the Dowlio menu offer the update. This starts with the next update after this one.
- **Choose what a finished download's notification does.** Settings › General › Clicking the notification opens Dowlio, shows the file in Finder, or opens the file in its usual app.
- **Settings from the Library window.** A gear next to the search field opens Settings.
- **Report a Problem in Settings.** It's in the new Help section of Settings › General.

## Before you update

- **Allow the keychain prompt.** After this update, macOS asks once whether Dowlio may read its saved browser pairings. Choose Always Allow. Your browsers stay paired.
